bellman_and_certificate.theorem_kind: elementary finite-model recurrence and relaxation argument, not novel industrial theorem
assumptions: correct known finite joint prior over outcomes and labels
finite fresh actions; zero-cost cached outputs cannot cause cycles
Bayes terminal decision for stated model or explicit allowed terminal rule
bellman_and_certificate.objective: expected terminal loss + alpha * expected evidence units under hard per-instance budget
bellman_and_certificate.v3_actual_objective: alpha=0; expected evidence cost breaks equal-loss ties lexicographically
bellman_and_certificate.lower_bound: L_free: expected Bayes terminal risk after all currently available evidence at zero acquisition cost with unrestricted decision rule
bellman_and_certificate.inequality: L_free <= V <= rho, for alpha>=0 under stated known model
bellman_and_certificate.invalid_substitute: fixed all-input teacher score is not L_free and is not guaranteed below partial-input loss
